comparison.objective: Tighten a castle nut to the next slot and insert a cotter pin without backing off; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Directionally constrained nut rotation and cross-hole pin insertion versus setscrew unlocking, collar adjustment, relocking and iterative response judgment.
comparison.success_condition: Body gives staged credit for clockwise alignment and pin insertion, with irreversible zero for >5° backing off; no complete spec version is present. Candidate uses cycle-energy, stroke and drift tests.
comparison.reason: Some rotary fastener handling overlaps, but the core tested ability—safe cotter-pin alignment—is materially different from damping calibration.
